summary: Build practical HR negotiation skills for employee relations, compensation, and workplace disputes. Explore the five-day course and enrol today.
lede: HR negotiation training helps HR business partners, employee relations specialists, and HR managers prepare for workplace agreements and difficult conversations. It covers interest mapping, BATNA and ZOPA assessment, concession planning, proposal development, and ethical responses to pressure tactics. Through realistic HR scenarios, participants practise conducting structured conversations, drafting agreement summaries, and tracking actions, with AI-assisted preparation and follow-up introduced at an applied overview level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for HR professionals who negotiate employment, employee relations, talent, and workplace outcomes. It suits intermediate practitioners who already manage people-related cases and need a more consistent approach to preparation, dialogue, agreement design, and follow-through.
audience: Trade Union and Employee Representative Liaisons
prerequisites: Working experience in HR, employee relations, talent acquisition, compensation, people operations, or line management is recommended. You should bring familiarity with internal HR policies and workplace case handling. No coding or specialist analytics software is required.
